incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the last 5 minutes (15:07:34Z–15:12:34Z) the ERROR-status span series returned for checkout were 0 for span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct; cart's POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart was also 0. The only non-zero ERROR series in that window was product-catalog's oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct at 1.2496 error spans. No ERROR-status series at all was returned for checkout's CurrencyService/Convert, CartService/GetCart, ShippingService/GetQuote or ShippingService/ShipOrder, so those are unknown rather than proven zero.

Checkout PlaceOrder latency in the last 5 minutes is not elevated against the available baseline: histogram_quantile(0.95) of traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="checkout",span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"} was 96.875 ms at 15:12:34, versus 95 ms (14:17:34) and 90 ms (14:22:34) before the incident and 96.875 ms (15:02:34) and 160 ms (15:07:34) after recovery; the mean was 60.75 ms versus 51.90 ms, 41.47 ms, 53.47 ms and 65.71 ms for those same windows. The last-5-minute PlaceOrder volume was 6.2478 spans (STATUS_CODE_UNSET), so these statistics rest on a handful of spans, and the baseline is only two pre-incident 5-minute windows.

Sampled checkout spans from 15:08:53Z–15:11:55Z are successful: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder in traces c29074ba53abaa3b74e1fca17900651d (69.508 ms), f47a0c4fc00d45763147d86dd6ee4a2e (68.527 ms), dd97bd207fa6757e4989a7839f3d97b8 (61.511 ms), 0d874eaffce34fa00ae63b14f38681fa (56.069 ms) and e555d3aeda0ae79b40ead74ab087f4d3 (48.145 ms) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code 0, their HTTP POST spans carry http.status_code 200, and their child calls to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote and ShipOrder all carry rpc.grpc.status_code 0. This is a 60-row slice of a 225-row result, so the 165 unread rows of those traces remain unknown.

The single product-catalog error in the last 5 minutes is trace 3ceb89fe0b8bd7550ea14a9713b3c37a at 15:12:30: product-catalog span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (432 µs) records otel.status_description 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled' with rpc.grpc.status_code 13, and the failure terminates in frontend GET /api/products/{productId} and executing api route /api/products/[productId] with http.status_code 500. The calling parent is frontend's grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct span, not a checkout span.

Checkout's own error counts were non-zero immediately before the last 5 minutes: in the 5-minute windows ending 15:02:34 and 15:07:34, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder had 1.25 and 1.2476 ERROR spans and checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct had 1.2291 and 1.2476 ERROR spans, while the window ending 15:12:34 shows 0 for both.

Trace 5e615b952d981e1c73671320abfccb1f at about 15:05:10 shows the product-catalog fault failing checkout: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (21.884 ms) carries error=true, rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and otel.status_description 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"OLJCESPC7Z"'; its child checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (551 µs) records 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled' with rpc.grpc.status_code 13, and the product-catalog server span records the same message; frontend POST /api/checkout and executing api route /api/checkout return http.status_code 500.

Earlier in the window checkout was both erroring and very slow: checkout oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart ERROR spans ran 1.25–5.01 per 5-minute window from the 14:27:34 evaluation through the 14:57:34 evaluation and returned to 0 from 15:02:34, while checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder mean duration was 13644.09 ms, 15968.95 ms, 69866.71 ms, 75008.04 ms, 52172.85 ms, 39597.03 ms and 27316.51 ms for those windows against 41.47–51.90 ms in the 14:17:34/14:22:34 windows, with p95 pinned at the 15000 ms histogram boundary from 14:32:34 to 14:57:34.

The latency originated inside cart, not in checkout: cart service span POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart averaged 13597.33 ms, 15907.33 ms, 63806.27 ms, 74959.63 ms, 51999.56 ms, 39530.37 ms and 27322.19 ms in the 14:27:34–14:57:34 windows, while in the same windows cart's HGET (0.38–0.70 ms), HMSET (0.25–1.01 ms), EXPIRE (0.18–0.43 ms) and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean (4.17–7.76 ms) spans stayed fast; cart's whole-service mean duration rose from 1.08–1.15 ms to 801–3513 ms and fell back to 1.45 ms (15:02:34), 1.44 ms (15:07:34) and 1.25 ms (15:12:34).

The deepest supported cause is cart's failure to connect to its Redis cart storage. In trace f41794c984d4a9fe117a3060d49cd222 (cart span start 14:32:19.9) cart's POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart span lasts 210094452 µs with error=true and otel.status_description 'Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() in /usr/src/app/src/cartstore/ValkeyCartStore.cs:line 95 … EmptyCartAsync(String userId) … line 178")'; the matching checkout client span oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart lasts 210694001 µs with error=true and rpc.grpc.status_code 9; checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder lasts 210739766 µs; frontend-proxy ingress and load-generator GET spans in the same trace return http.status_code 504 after about 15.0 s.

Dependency latency for checkout in the last 5 minutes stayed at millisecond scale, measured as increase(duration sum)/increase(duration count) over checkout client spans with service_name="checkout": oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 5.72 ms, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 2.60 ms, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 11.71 ms, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 2.96 ms, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 2.06 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 10.90 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 0.65 ms — comparable to the 14:17:34/14:22:34 values of 6.69/7.63, 1.23/2.93, 9.00/9.25, 1.82/2.56, 0.59/0.63, 4.89/7.25 and 1.01/0.72 ms, with GetQuote and GetProduct slightly higher but still single-digit to low-double-digit milliseconds.

The slow-failure trace shows the stall was specific to cart EmptyCart rather than a general checkout or network problem: in trace f41794c984d4a9fe117a3060d49cd222 checkout's other dependency calls succeeded quickly — oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 4524 µs, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 870–2582 µs, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 2358 µs, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 7496 µs, ShipOrder 353 µs and product-catalog GetProduct 287–966 µs, all with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 — and cart's own POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart child completed in 412 µs.

Rejected: payment failures explain the checkout error report in the last 5 minutes. In the 15:07:34–15:12:34 window checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge had 0 ERROR spans and payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge had 0 ERROR spans, checkout's rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count for oteldemo.PaymentService Charge with rpc_grpc_status_code 2 was 0 at 15:12:34, and payment's whole-service mean span duration was 2.25 ms against 2.21/2.26 ms in the pre-incident windows.

Rejected: currency, shipping or email were failing or slow in the last 5 minutes. No ERROR-status span series was returned for those services in the window, and their whole-service mean span durations at 15:12:34 were 1.26 ms (currency), 5.90 ms (shipping) and 3.69 ms (email) versus 0.76/0.96 ms, 2.52/3.74 ms and 5.58/2.81 ms in the pre-incident windows; the sampled spans carry otel.status_code OK and rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and email POST /send_order_confirmation returns http.status_code 200.

Rejected: flagd EventStream errors account for the checkout symptoms. flagd and ad flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream ERROR counts of about 1.25 recur in alternating 5-minute windows across the whole hour, including the 14:22:34 window (1.25) in which checkout PlaceOrder had 0 ERROR spans and a p95 of 90 ms, so the series does not track the checkout event.

gaps: Why cart lost its Redis/Valkey connection is unresolved: the kubernetes_state, pod_logs and change_history integrations are not available in this Run, so no pod restart, readiness or configuration change evidence exists for cart or its Redis instance.
The Redis/Valkey instance itself emits no spans or metrics in the queried data (no redis service appears in the trace service list), so its availability and resource state are unknown.
rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="cart"} returned no data, so there is no server-side gRPC status or duration breakdown for cart to cross-check the trace-level findings.

Trace sampling: the last-5-minute checkout trace result held 225 span rows and only 60 were read (165 unread rows unknown); the product-catalog and cart searches were returned at their trace limit ('backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist'), so the sampled traces are biased samples, not complete graphs.

Latency baselines are thin: the pre-incident baseline for checkout PlaceOrder consists of only two 5-minute evaluation points (14:17:34, 14:22:34), and each 5-minute statistic rests on roughly six PlaceOrder spans, so small latency deltas cannot be classified confidently.

Whether the product-catalog 'Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled' fault was still active after the last observed occurrence at 15:12:30 (trace 3ceb89fe0b8bd7550ea14a9713b3c37a) is unknown; error and/or missing series cannot establish continuation.
app_payment_transactions_total and other payment-specific transaction counters were not examined, so payment success/failure at the transaction level beyond span status is unknown.

report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes of the authorized window (2026-11-03T15:07:34Z–15:12:34Z) checkout does not show elevated errors or elevated latency: every ERROR-status span series returned for checkout is 0, checkout PlaceOrder's 95th percentile is 96.875 ms against a pre-incident baseline of 95 ms and 90 ms, and the sampled checkout traces are 48–70 ms PlaceOrder calls with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 / HTTP 200. The only non-zero ERROR series in that 5-minute window is product-catalog's oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (1.2496 error spans), and the trace behind it (3ceb89fe0b8bd7550ea14a9713b3c37a) failed a frontend product-page request, not a checkout request. The elevated checkout errors that were reported are visible earlier in the authorized window and resolve into two distinct causes: (1) cart could not reach its Redis cart storage, producing 'Can't access cart storage … Wasn't able to connect to redis' on POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (trace f41794c984d4a9fe117a3060d49cd222, cart server span 210.09 s, checkout client span 210.69 s with rpc.grpc.status_code 9) with checkout PlaceOrder averaging 13.6–75.0 s between the 14:27:34 and 14:57:34 windows and frontend-proxy/load-generator 504s; and (2) the product-catalog fault 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled', which failed a checkout PlaceOrder with gRPC 13 at 15:05:10 (trace 5e615b952d981e1c73671320abfccb1f). Both were clear of checkout's own signals by the last 5 minutes. Currency, shipping, email and payment show no error series and single-digit-millisecond durations in the last 5 minutes.
